text: jordan: quick heads-up — ran the nightly kb link-scan and found a broken anchor on /runtime/optimizations.md -> #kv-cache-behavior. Page renders but anchor 404s. link: https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/optimizations.md#kv-cache-behavior maria: thanks for flagging. do we have a frontmatter owner on that page? kev: looks like owner is missing (scan shows null). docs-bot: page metadata check: owner=null, last_edited=2024-11-04, size=12.3KB :robot_face: jordan: yeah owner blank. can someone pick this up? quick fix is to add an anchor or update the TOC. the problematic link is from /internals/caching.md referencing that anchor. olivia: I can do a small patch — will verify which anchor to keep. do we prefer stable anchors (dash-case) vs generated heading ids? maria: prefer explicit anchor in the doc body to avoid renderer churn. suggest adding an HTML anchor right above the heading: `````` and also add owner to frontmatter: ```yaml owner: @olivia team: eng-runtime ``` kev: SGTM. olivia — want me to open the PR for you? I can run linkcheck in CI. olivia: please do. I'll write a 1-line change and add a tiny test. thanks! :raised_hands: docs-bot: auto-created issue #4927 referencing 1715554321 - "anchor missing on runtime optimizations". assignable by @editors. sam: quick note — when adding frontmatter owner use display name without @ (our parser expects plain name). e.g. `owner: olivia` jordan: good catch. olivia/can you also add a redirect in case other pages use the older anchor? small one-liner: `````` or just update callers. olivia: I'll update the callers instead of meta redirect. kev, can you run the KB link-scan after the PR? kev: yup. I'll queue the scan after the merge and post results here. maria: timeline? olivia: will open PR in ~30m, request review from @maria and @kev. jordan: thanks all. closing loop: if scan passes, we'll add a tiny note to the release notes under docs maintenance. :white_check_mark:
